secured-server space at occupancy, and suitable low-voltage infrastructure; require Energy Star labeling within one year, with LEED preferred."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Draft building-owner and developer solicitation materials stating location, floor-area and floorplate needs, operational requirements, completion schedule, and financial requirements."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Conduct pre-proposal conferences and answer inquiries, market the opportunity, initially assess responses and building compliance, and arrange site tours for CPA staff and design consultants."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Evaluate proposals and perform due diligence, establish lease and move-in improvement costs, and recommend a shortlist of facilities."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Obtain CPA pre-approval of negotiating strategies, negotiate incentives and concessions, and document negotiations, terms, and letters of intent."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Present the recommended transaction and terms for CPA approval, supporting a governing-committee presentation if needed."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Prepare or coordinate lease documentation to finalize the approved
